title: Guest Care Standards Schedule — Travel Issues, Major Disruptive Events and Reviews
content:
# Guest Care Standards — schedule

The figures below apply to travel-issue reports, major-disruptive-event refunds and reviews on reservations in the Stays (Guest Reservations) category. They are identical on all eight cancellation policies (Flexible, Moderate, Limited, Firm, Strict, Super Strict 30 Days, Super Strict 60 Days and Long-Term).

## Travel issues

| Setting | Value on every policy |
|---|---|
| Elapsed hours after the guest discovered a travel issue within which it must be reported | 72 |

| Travel-issue category | Percent of the affected nights' nightly amount refunded on an approved travel issue | Cleaning fee also refunded in full when reported on the check-in date |
|---|---|---|
| No access (the guest cannot get in) | 100.00% | Yes |
| Uninhabitable (unsafe or unsanitary) | 100.00% | Yes |
| Misrepresented (differs materially from the listing) | 50.00% | No |
| Amenity missing (an essential listed amenity is missing) | 25.00% | No |

## Major disruptive events

| Setting | Value on every policy |
|---|---|
| Percent of every collected component for unspent nights refunded on an approved major-disruptive-event request | 100.00% |

## Reviews

| Setting | Value on every policy |
|---|---|
| Calendar days after the check-out date within which guest and host may each submit a review | 14 |
| Each side may submit only one review per stay | Yes |

## Illustration (hypothetical case)

A guest who discovered a hypothetical travel issue at 20:00 on 2026-07-04 has until 20:00 on 2026-07-07, 72 elapsed hours later, to report it. If the issue is a missing essential amenity, the share set here is 25.00% of the affected nights' nightly amount, and the cleaning fee is not among the categories refunded in full.
